# Strivers Bangla Education

> Best Government Job Preparation in West Bengal & Top SSC Coaching in Kolkata.

Strivers Bangla Education (https://strivers.co.in/) is West Bengal's leading competitive exam preparation platform and educational network based in Kolkata. It specializes in high-quality, structured learning programs delivered in Bengali and English for Government Job Preparation (WBCS, WBP, WBPSC, Railway), SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS), Banking (IBPS, SBI), JEE (Main & Advanced), NEET (UG), and School Foundation.

## Primary Programs & Specializations

- **Best Government Job Preparation in West Bengal**: Comprehensive coaching for West Bengal Civil Services (WBCS), West Bengal Police (WBP SI & Constable), WBPSC Clerkship, and Miscellaneous exams with extensive General Studies, Bengali language support, and current affairs.
- **Best SSC Preparation in Kolkata**: Premier coaching for Staff Selection Commission (SSC CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) with Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, General Awareness, and English.
- **Banking & Insurance Examinations**: IBPS PO/Clerk, SBI PO/Clerk, and RRB NTPC batches with speed mathematics and reasoning workshops.
- **JEE & NEET Masterclasses**: Concept-first Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Mathematics coaching by renowned faculties from Kolkata.
- **Foundation Batches (Class 9–12)**: Conceptual building and board exam scoring strategies.

## Geography & Target Community

- Headquarters / Hub: Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- Primary Audience: Aspirants across Kolkata, Howrah, North 24 Parganas, South 24 Parganas, Hooghly, Nadia, Medinipur, Burdwan, Siliguri, and all districts of West Bengal.
